neighbours.label: ' have' after a modal in a perfect ('would have', 'may have')
fire: Measure 12 would have raised school taxes.
The results may have looked convincing at first.
Those birds may have been larger than modern eagles.
Our parents would have filled the old stadium.
The plan would have closed three hospitals.
The early settlers may have traded with the coast.
This law would have banned plastic bags.
The fire may have started in the kitchen.

notes: Main-verb ' have' and 'have to' stayed at or below 0.006 in probes. The declared token includes those, so measured coverage overstates the label.
